chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

It is inevitable for the Master of this command to have an Occultation, and it is inevitable for him during his Occultation to have seclusion. Excellent is the dwelling of Ṭaybah, and with thirty there is no loneliness.

key_terms.صَاحِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the Master of this command; the divinely designated holder of the affair
key_terms.عُزْلَةٍ: seclusion or isolation during that hidden period
key_terms.غَيْبَةٍ: occultation; a state of hiddenness from public appearance

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kāfī say about the ghaybah and seclusion of the Master of the affair?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the صاحب of this أمر will necessarily undergo a ghaybah and seclusion. It also praises Ṭaybah as a dwelling place and indicates that the presence of thirty removes loneliness, reflecting conditions associated with the period of occultation.
